in_tamil.name: அகேலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is alone or solitary

in_marathi.name: Akela
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akela हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Akela means 'solitary' or 'unattached'. It is derived from the root word 'akul' which means 'alone'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to possess the strength and courage to face life's challenges alone.
